title: List of features and items that affect attack rolls
html:
This is a comprehensive list of all sources of effects that directly affect attack rolls.

General information

This page lists all the bonuses and penalties which apply to attack rolls. Attacking with  Advantage has a major impact on the outcome of attack rolls, but such effects are not listed here. For a complete list of those effects, see List of sources of advantage and disadvantage on attack rolls.

General features

Feature Attack roll bonus Affects
 Great Weapon Master: All In −5 (toggleable) Melee weapons wielded with two hands
        High ground 2 or −2 Any attack made at 2.5 m / 8 ft above or below a target
 Favourable Beginnings Proficiency bonus Any attack against creatures who have not been targeted by Favourable Beginnings
 Sharpshooter: All In −5 (toggleable) Ranged Weapon Attacks
 Tavern Brawler STR modifier Unarmed attacks and throwing attacks

Notes

  1. ↑ If the target is affected by both  Bleeding and  Poisoned, the attack roll bonus is applied twice.

  3. ↑ 3.0 3.1 3.2 3.3 This effect has the same Stack ID as  Bless and cannot stack with it or any other effect with the same ID.
  4. ↑ The tooltip incorrectly says that the attack roll bonus applies only to spells.
  5. ↑ 5.0 5.1 5.2 These elemental weapon effects all share the same Stack ID and cannot stack with each other.
